title: SynSci 2026 keynote in Glasgow
description: Dr Di Fu delivered the keynote “Embodied AI in Multimodal Human-Robot Social Interaction” at the SynSci-Synergy for Science 2026 satellite session in Glasgow on 13 July 2026. During her visit, she met colleagues and visited research laboratories in the University of Glasgow’s School of Psychology & Neuroscience and School of Computing Science.

zh.title: 格拉斯哥 SynSci 2026 主旨演讲
zh.description: 2026 年 7 月 13 日，Di Fu 博士在格拉斯哥举行的 SynSci-Synergy for Science 2026 卫星会议上作题为“多模态人机社会交互中的具身 AI”的主题演讲。访问期间，她还与同事交流，并参观了格拉斯哥大学心理学与神经科学学院及计算机科学学院的研究实验室。
